component.name: TorrentX
component.summary: Native Rust torrent search GUI powered by Jackett

description.p: TorrentX queries all of your Jackett indexers from one fast, native desktop app. Search 100+ trackers simultaneously or pick a single indexer, then filter, sort, and act on results without leaving the window.

ul.li: Filters: text, minimum seeds, size, year, tracker, health, category chips
Batch mode: select many rows and copy all magnet links at once
Favorites and search history, persisted locally
RSS feeds (Torznab) with background auto-refresh and guid-based dedupe
19 themes (16 dark, 3 light) with custom accent color
CSV export, keyboard-driven workflow, system tray, desktop notifications

description.p: Requires a running Jackett instance (http://localhost:9117 by default) with your trackers configured.

ul.li: The episode/file picker lists real files again (webtorrent-cli 6 broke the old listing)
Play opens the player in under a second from the cached .torrent
A slow indexer is capped at 20 s in an All search
The status line shows how many indexers have answered
Small labels and headings are a step larger and more legible
Settings Display is laid out on two lines instead of one dense row
Settings › Display › Scale enlarges the whole interface (80-150%)
Ctrl + and Ctrl − zoom in 5% steps, Ctrl 0 resets
Picking a past search fills the box and searches again
The clear button sits inside the search field and resets the results
A failing RSS feed backs off instead of being retried on every tick
A failed fetch no longer shows a green "ok · 0 items" pill
"Choose episode" opens the detail panel and shows what it is doing
One instance per profile; --minimized; durable config saves; edition 2024
--version and --help no longer panic on Windows release builds
First verified launch on a Windows VM: the window paints and writes its config
Error messages no longer print the Jackett API key when Jackett answers with HTML or bad JSON
"At login" is a Linux-only control instead of a no-op elsewhere
Settings → At login: start with your session so RSS feeds keep polling
CI now rejects the two lock spellings that silently dropped state updates
One lock convention: a crashed worker no longer leaves the window stuck on "Searching"
Right-click menu on every column of the results table
A crashed indexer thread no longer takes the window down with it
Faster release builds (thin LTO); the two 1000-line UI screens split by concern
Filtering, sorting and paging logic covered by unit tests
Dual MIT OR Apache-2.0 licence, both texts shipped in the bundle
Licence notices readable and copyable; Settings is one clean pill
Fix search race: stale responses can no longer overwrite newer results
Fix shortcut hijacking while typing; working software-GL fallback
Indexer list auto-retry; window size and tab restore
Performance: single filter/sort pass per frame, Arc-shared results
Security: CSV formula-injection guard, URL scheme allow-list
About tab credits + install ID; RSS guid-based dedupe
